items.title: How much does a small ratio change compound?
items.description: A type scale multiplies a base size by a ratio at each step. This shows a heading 3 steps above body text (body → small heading → medium heading → large heading), starting from the 16px body size used in L2's examples. Drag the ratio and watch how a barely-there difference at ratio 1.05 becomes a full headline by 1.5 — the same multiplier applied 3 times compounds fast.

items.title: What contrast ratio does a text/background pair actually produce?
items.description: This runs the exact WCAG relative-luminance formula from L2 and L3 on grayscale values. The default (white background, #767676-equivalent text at 46% lightness) reproduces this unit's borderline 4.54:1 example. Drag the text lightness toward the background and watch the ratio collapse below the AA line (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text/UI); drag it toward black and watch it clear AAA (7:1).
items.compute: function lum(v) { var c = v / 255; return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); } var bg = lum(params.bgLightness / 100 * 255); var fg = lum(params.textLightness / 100 * 255); var lighter = Math.max(bg, fg); var darker = Math.min(bg, fg); return { ratio: (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05) };
